args.message: Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212

args.body:
## Summary
`round_money` in `src/money.py` was documented as banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN, per FIN-212) but actually used `ROUND_HALF_UP`, which caused `tests/test_money.py` to fail in the nightly build.

## Change
- Switch the rounding mode from `ROUND_HALF_UP` to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`.

## Verification
- CI run `ci-0001` on `08d3cd5986` passed.

transcript.reasoning_content: Docstring says ROUND_HALF_EVEN but code uses ROUND_HALF_UP. Test: 2.675 → 2.68 (half-even on exact decimal 2.675: digit before is 7 (odd) → rounds up to 2.68 ✓). 2.665 → 2.66 ✓. Fix by changing to ROUND_HALF_EVEN.
